task.name: Install_flame_effect_system
task.when: During Build after the supporting structure passes inspection

resources.resource: Flame Lead, Power Lead, and trained flame crew

step.action: Confirm that the installation drawing and operating procedure match the FAST-submitted flame-effect scenario.
Install every rated fuel component in the exact drawing location and orientation.
Install the single labeled quarter-turn emergency shutoff in its approved visible location.
Secure every cylinder upright and protect the installation from vehicle traffic.
Establish the FAST-approved audience perimeter and 20-foot combustible-free zone.
Have the Power Lead install de-energized electrical components according to the approved drawing.
Perform the pre-inspection leak test according to 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure under the Flame Lead and any required FAST supervision.
step.ifThen: IF any connection fails, THEN keep the system out of service until the Flame Lead corrects and retests it.

step.action: Have FAST physically inspect the completed installation.
step.ifThen: IF FAST does not approve the installation, THEN do not test or operate it.

step.action: Place the issued 🔥 Flame_Effect_Burn_License with the licensed operator.

passWhen.criterion: The installation matches the FAST-submitted drawing and uses only rated components.
The emergency shutoff, cylinder securement, vehicle protection, and approved perimeter are complete.
FAST approved the physical installation and issued the current burn license.
